item.text:
**Verdict:** mixed, leaning negative. Erdoğan’s 2024 record includes some real, targeted help for vulnerable people, especially earthquake survivors, refugees, women, youth, and retirees. But the broader pattern still looks selective and politically mediated, with strong evidence of exclusion or repression of Kurds, women, LGBT people, and refugees rather than a consistent priority for marginalized groups.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | Turkey - Socially Inclusive Green Transition Project | World Bank | 2024-03-06 | [link](https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099031124170520652) | The project’s stated objective is to improve women and youth economic opportunities, including finance for women- and youth-led MSMEs, local infrastructure, and support in less developed areas. This is one of the clearest pro-vulnerable-group signals in the record, though it is a program document rather than a direct Erdoğan speech or decree. | 6B.3; also 6B.2, 5B.8 |
| Positive | World Bank to Support Women, Youth Owned Small Businesses and Industry Adapt to Green Transition in Türkiye | World Bank | 2024-04-01 | [link](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/03/29/world-bank-to-support-women-youth-owned-small-businesses-and-industry-adapt-to-green-transition-in-turkiye) | The World Bank said the financing was meant to make the transition more equitable and inclusive, especially for women, youth, and vulnerable groups in less developed areas. This supports a fairness-oriented reading, but the evidence is still indirect. | 6B.3; also 6B.2, 5B.8 |
| Positive | Turkey completes new homes in area hit by devastating earthquake | Reuters | 2024-02-03 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-completes-new-homes-in-area-hit-by-devastating-earthquake-3291916) | Erdoğan’s government handed over 7,275 homes in Hatay and said more reconstruction was coming. This is concrete support for a poor, disaster-hit region and the strongest direct regional-housing priority I found. | 6B.3; also 6B.2, 5B.10 |
| Positive | Turkey to work for Syrian migrants to return home safely, minister says | Reuters | 2024-12-09 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-to-work-for-syrian-migrants-to-return-home-safely-minister-says-3760765) | Turkey said it would open the Yayladagi border gate to manage safe, voluntary return and prevent congestion after Assad’s fall. That is a limited but real protective response for displaced Syrians and refugees. | 6B.3; also 6B.2, 5B.8 |
| Positive | Turkey to lift minimum retirement pay, impose minimum corporate tax | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-07-16 | [link](https://theprint.in/world/turkey-to-lift-minimum-retirement-pay-impose-minimum-corporate-tax/2176793/) | Reuters described the minimum-pension increase as targeted relief in an inflationary environment. It is evidence that elderly people were not ignored, though the narrowness makes it look more like selective relief than a broad social-protection strategy. | 6B.3; also 6B.2, 5B.7, 5B.8 |
| Negative | Turkey: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report | Freedom House | 2024 | [link](https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House says AKP politics favored Sunni Muslims, Kurdish parties faced harassment, women and LGBT people remained politically marginalized, and refugees faced severe restrictions and anti-foreigner rhetoric. This is direct evidence against prioritizing vulnerable or marginalized communities equally. | 6B.3; also 5B.8, 6B.1 |
| Negative | World Report 2024: Türkiye | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | [link](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey) | HRW says women and girls still lacked effective protection from domestic violence, anti-LGBT hate speech was central to the campaign, and Pride events were repeatedly banned with arrests. That is strong evidence that vulnerable groups were not a core governing priority. | 6B.3; also 6B.2, 5B.8 |
| Negative | Turkey ousts 3 elected pro-Kurdish mayors from office and replaces them with state officials | AP | 2024-11-04 | [link](https://apnews.com/article/5aba9ba471ecc222c6fbba535a9e6546) | The government removed elected pro-Kurdish mayors and replaced them with state officials over terrorism-related charges. This points to coercive political treatment of Kurdish constituencies rather than prioritization of minority welfare. | 6B.3; also 5B.8, 4B.10 |
| Negative | Shock, confusion as Turkey seizes earthquake survivors' homes | Reuters | 2024-03-18 | [link](https://www.reuters.com/commodities/shock-confusion-as-turkey-seizes-earthquake-survivors-homes-2024-03-18/) | Reuters reported deed transfers in Hatay to the Treasury under an urban-planning amendment, alarming survivors. This is a major trust and housing-security failure in a disaster zone, cutting against a vulnerable-group-first reading. | 6B.3; also 6B.2, 5B.8, 5B.9 |
| Negative | Dark days for Turks as Erdogan atones for economic errors | Reuters | 2024-07-18 | [link](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/dark-days-for-turks-as-erdogan-atones-for-economic-errors-2024-07-18/) | Reuters described eroding living standards, years of punishing inflation, and a sharp credit clampdown. That matters here because persistent cost-of-living pain falls hardest on poor, elderly, and otherwise vulnerable households. | 6B.3; also 5B.7, 5B.9, 5B.10 |

Search gap: I found some targeted support for vulnerable groups, but very little direct 2024 evidence of broad improvements for children, the disabled, or sustained anti-poverty protection across the board. Most positive evidence is localized or programmatic; most system-level evidence points the other way.
